items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27
items.q: I said no no I said Freddie get out of here.

ctx.x: do. You know Freddie Williams? No. Detective in the Roosevelt Hotel? No. I don't know. What did he play? Trombone? He played trombone he was a kid too you know. But he was getting by the neck and shove him up against

the wall. I put him out to tell you why. Because he beat Georgie Brunis. And I wasn't going to let nobody do that. I wasn't going to do it. He was bigger. He was big too. I told him I said no you ain't gonna do nothing of the kind. And he broke a chair trying to hit Georgie with it. And then they got back in the yard and I don't know what he wasn't doing to I said no no I said Freddie get out of here. Get your hat and get out of here. I
got wine soft drinks whiskey and coffee what did have? Whiskey whiskey wine had you No beer. You got a Coke?
